name: Torrent (Ray Kinsel), 2 May 2008
notes: the file's 7 in fin can (4.125 in, a 0.05 in shoulder: a 1.25 slope step) is flown as the 4 in tube: the fin root starts 2.5 in ahead of the can, and the 3D mesher refuses a fin root across a step; motor: AMW M1850GG, the thrust curve estimated from the TRA graph by John DeMar (ThrustCurve.org simfile 5f4294d20002e9000000010a), which the bundled catalogue does not hold
source: RASAero II Comparisons with Altitude Data, https://www.rasaero.com/comparisons-alt.htm (C. E. Rogers); geometry, weights, motor and site from the example file shipped with the free RASAero II download, https://www.rasaero.com/dl_software_ii.htm (RASAero_II_Setup_Version_1.0.2.0.zip, Examples/Torrent.CDX1)
